teacher_info.about_teacher: I love teaching and helping students to feel more comfortable and confident speaking English in real-world conversations.  I am also a language learner.  I have lived abroad in Spain and France and I know how difficult and scary it can be to practice speaking in a new language.  I know how important it is to find a teacher with whom you feel very comfortable and safe so that you can practice speaking, ask questions, and take risks.  This is the best way to take your skills to the next level!  It is my goal to be that teacher for you!  My teaching style is relational, I am invested in my students and I am so excited to see you gaining confidence in your speaking ability!
teacher_info.teaching_style: My adult lessons are conversation-based and thematic.  Each lesson will be centered on a topic and I will ask you related discussion questions.  I can provide you with questions before class so that you can prepare, if that makes you more comfortable.  The classes are relaxed and feel much like having a conversation with a friend. I will also include important grammar points and pronunciation points when they arise in class.  I will also provide you with new vocabulary and phrases/idioms during each class so that your vocabulary is always expanding. Some examples of class topics are: introductions, hobbies, free time, sports, movies, books, food, family, holidays, music, and many more!

teacher_info.introduction: After attaining my TEFL/TESOL certification in 2015, I traveled to South America where I taught children, teenagers, and adults along a broad spectrum of proficiency levels. While most of my teaching experience is in Spanish-speaking countries, my background in Anthropology allows me to connect with people from all over the world. While living abroad, I quickly realized that grammar and pronunciation were not the most important parts of language learning. The key is confidence! Remaining silent for fear of making mistakes hurts you more in the end. Mistakes are opportunities to learn, so don't let insecurity keep you from communicating! Why is it easier for us to repeat song lyrics in another language than to remember the verb tenses (past, present, future)? You might say that the first is entertaining while the second is serious. Well, I happen to believe that learning a new language can be just as fun. I customize topics based on what you are interested in: nature, music, sports, food, etc. I also challenge my students to incorporate English into their daily life through movies, social media, games, books, etc. Sound fun? Good! Let's start learning.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for beginners) Inglés para principiantes
pro_course_detail.description:
This comprehensive ESL course is structured to take students from beginner to high-beginner proficiency.  By completing this course, students will gain confidence in speaking, listening, reading, and writing in English, preparing them for real-world communication.  

The course focuses on:  
- **Grammar**: Progressing from basic structures (*be verbs*, *present simple*, *past simple*, *future (going to)*) to more complex structures (*can/can't, comparatives, superlatives, present perfect*).  
- **Vocabulary**: Covering a wide range of topics, including numbers, nationalities, family, food, daily routines, and more.  
- **Pronunciation**: Emphasizing key English sounds, stress patterns, and rhythm to develop clear spoken communication.  
- **Speaking & Listening**: Engaging activities, dialogues, and real-life conversations to improve fluency and comprehension.  
- **Reading & Writing**: Practicing sentence structure, reading comprehension, and writing tasks ranging from simple messages to structured paragraphs.  
- **Practical English**: Everyday functional language, such as ordering food, asking for directions, making small talk, and handling real-world situations.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Communication**: Exploring cultural differences in communication, idiomatic expressions, and social norms.  
- **Review & Progress Checks**: Regular revision exercises and practical challenges to reinforce learning and track progress.

pro_course_detail.title: (English for intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes intermedios
pro_course_detail.description:
Intermediate ESL Course for Confident Communication

This course is designed to help students at an intermediate level develop fluency and accuracy in English through engaging lessons that focus on:

Grammar Mastery: Strengthening sentence structures, tenses, and complex grammatical forms to express ideas clearly.
Expanded Vocabulary: Learning and using a wide range of words and phrases for everyday conversations, work, and travel.
Pronunciation Practice: Improving clarity and natural rhythm in speech through targeted exercises.
Speaking & Listening Skills: Engaging in discussions, role-plays, and real-world scenarios to build confidence in communication.
Reading & Writing Development: Understanding diverse texts, improving comprehension, and refining writing skills for emails, reports, and storytelling.
Practical English for Everyday Situations: Handling real-life interactions such as ordering in restaurants, solving travel problems, and making social connections.
Cultural Awareness & Social English: Navigating conversations with native speakers and understanding language in different contexts.
Regular Progress Checks: Reviewing learning through assessments and interactive activities to reinforce knowledge.
By the end of this course, students will have the tools to communicate effectively in a variety of real-life situations, gaining confidence and proficiency in English

pro_course_detail.title: (English for upper intermediate students) Inglés para estudiantes de nivel intermedio superior
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Effective Communication**  
This is a well-structured, practical, and engaging curriculum. Each phase builds on the previous one, reinforcing knowledge while introducing new grammatical concepts in a way that feels organic and applicable to real-life communication.

This course is designed for students who want to refine their English skills and achieve a higher level of fluency and accuracy.

 The lessons focus on:  
- **Advanced Grammar & Structures**: Mastering complex sentence forms, including passive voice, conditionals, relative clauses, and reported speech.  
- **Expanded Vocabulary & Expressions**: Learning idiomatic expressions, phrasal verbs, and specialized vocabulary for different contexts.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation**: Developing a natural rhythm and clarity in speech through stress and intonation practice.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Real Situations**: Engaging in debates, storytelling, and discussions on various topics to build confidence in spontaneous conversation.  
- **Reading & Writing for Different Purposes**: Analyzing and producing formal and informal texts, including essays, reports, and narratives.  
- **Functional & Social English**: Navigating professional and social interactions, handling difficult conversations, and expressing nuanced opinions.  
- **Cultural Insights & Language in Context**: Understanding language variations, cultural references, and communication styles.  
- **Comprehensive Review & Practical Application**: Regular assessments and real-life applications to track progress and solidify learning.  

By the end of this course, students will have the skills to communicate effectively in both casual and professional environments, enhancing their confidence in English.

pro_course_detail.title: Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
**Advanced ESL Course for Mastery and Fluency**  

This course is designed for students who want to achieve full fluency and command of English at an advanced level. The lessons focus on:  

- **Sophisticated Grammar & Nuanced Structures**: Exploring advanced topics such as past modals, inversion, ellipsis, cleft sentences, and distancing language to enhance precision in communication.  
- **Rich & Diverse Vocabulary**: Expanding knowledge of idioms, phrasal verbs, colloquial expressions, and topic-based vocabulary in areas like psychology, business, and global issues.  
- **Pronunciation & Intonation Refinement**: Perfecting natural rhythm, connected speech, and stress patterns for clear, confident, and native-like pronunciation.  
- **Speaking & Listening in Complex Contexts**: Engaging in in-depth discussions, debates, and professional conversations, and understanding a variety of accents and fast-paced speech.  
- **Reading & Writing for Academic & Professional Purposes**: Analyzing complex texts, writing structured essays, reports, and opinion pieces, and refining formal and informal writing styles.  
- **Social & Professional Communication**: Mastering English for networking, interviews, presentations, and persuasive discussions in both formal and casual settings.  
- **Cultural Awareness & Idiomatic English**: Understanding how language reflects cultural nuances, improving adaptability in global communication.  
- **Personalized Review & Application**: Frequent assessments, real-life simulations, and practical exercises to ensure measurable progress.  

By the end of this course, students will have achieved an advanced level of fluency, enabling them to communicate naturally and effectively in any setting, from academic to professional and everyday life.

pro_course_detail.description:

There, the ideas, the stories, and the unique turns-of-phrase and rhythms that built the modern spoken language lay waiting to be discovered. They lend themselves to a deeper understanding of the target language and allow us to build a more personal relationship with it. 

The advantages of a literary education are not only aesthetic but, above all, practical. A knowledge of literature exposes the student to a much wider and more powerful range of vocabulary than most conversational courses, while also teaching higher level grammar and syntax, greater comprehension, an ear for eloquence, and important cultural allusions. 

For this type of lesson, you are free to select any classic work of literature, poetry, philosophy, politics, etc. and I will read it with you chapter by chapter, and build lessons based upon your desired outcome. I can also take the lead and offer a general English language literature course, or general assistance in understanding a literary work (a holistic approach). 

This course may appeal especially to college students who are struggling through a difficult English language text, though, this is truly for everyone who wants to deepen and broaden their knowledge of English, and perhaps—just perhaps—learn to enjoy the fruits of their labor.

course_info.trial_description:
It usually feels very scary to book a first lesson. Maybe you have had bad experiences with English learning in the past. Perhaps it feels strange to meet a stranger on a computer. And of course - trying something new is always scary! And I'm a new person and learning English this way - may be a new thing for you! 

But please don't worry! You're not alone. Nearly EVERYONE feels this way. It was the same for me when I had my first online class. 

I will bring care and empathy to every lesson, and especially the first one. In the trial lesson, I won't be evaluating you. I will not correct your mistakes on our first call together. 

Instead - my intention is that you feel comfortable and relaxed. I want you to see what I am like as a teacher, and I want to get to know you! 

I know your abilities are better than they will appear in this first class, because you will probably be nervous. That's totally normal! We're humans! 

I will listen without judgement and offer a lot of empathy. I will let you speak. I will give you the opportunity to really be heard.

This will allow us to see if working together makes sense. If we decide to continue with another class, what you share in the trial lesson will help me design personalized classes for you - based on your interests, lifestyle needs, goals, strengths, and challenges. 

I hope this makes sense. If you don't understand anything, or if you have any questions - please message me!!!

I look forward to meeting you soon!

pro_course_detail.title: GETTING REAL: Conversations for people who don't like small talk
pro_course_detail.description:
For many people, even native English speakers, "small talk" is boring.

If you're learning English and you're someone who prefers to talk about deeper, more personal or meaningful topics -- small talk can be very unpleasant. 

I understand! That's how I feel. I don't like talking about the weather or what I did yesterday or what I am going to do for vacation/holiday.

Instead, I like to hear what people really think, what they have experienced in their lives, and what they care about.

I give students the opportunity to talk about what they LIKE to talk about. Things that interest them. What they like to think and learn about. Their lives. Their world. 

Getting a chance to actually converse, in English, might be just what you're missing - and it can help build your confidence and increase your motivation.

My students are usually people who like to learn - and outside of class they enjoy learning about psychology, philosophy, personal growth, art, creativity, entrepreneurship, and many other things. 

In our classes, I provide a space for students to talk about these topics - to engage with the material they watch or listen to. To share what they're learning and what it means to them. 

I hope you'll try out these classes - and tell me what you REALLY think! Let's engage in interesting conversations IN ENGLISH!

pro_course_detail.title: Accent Reduction (North American Neutral Accent)
pro_course_detail.description:
As of 3/29/2024 I will only be offering 45 and 30 minute classes of this specific lesson. If you have already booked 1 hour lessons, we will continue to do those until the end of your package. 
In these lessons, I break down each of the sounds that ESL students struggle with the most. We use diagrams, mouth positioning exercises and listening exercises to really get into the physical reason behind why accents happen. I emphasize and practice intonation and cadence in class. I focus on helping the student perfect the pronunciation of some of the most difficult sounds in the English language such as "schwa", long & short vowel sounds, consonant endings and the dreaded "r" sound amongst others.

Each lesson is taught surrounding a particular topic and I aim to tailor the class topics according to the students' interests, for example, if a student likes Art, I try to provide Art related lessons.
We go over each exercise together where I explain, answer questions, correct pronunciation and have speaking moments with the student. Book a trial with me!

In these classes I provide the study material to the student and we work on business vocabulary, business idioms and business phrasal verbs. We discuss business situations, for example, leading a meeting or making an appointment. 
We also learn how to write business emails and do listening and speaking exercises. Last but not least, I teach students about business etiquette and business culture in the United States.

In these classes we use my experience to prepare the student for their upcoming interview. We learn how to write proper resumes and cover letters. 
We practice how to answer questions properly, proper etiquette and what to ask. I also do several mock interviews with the student where I provide feedback so the student can improve every weak point.
